items.title: How long could drift go unnoticed, depending on how often you check?
items.description: Drag how often drift detection actually runs (a scheduled job, or a manual habit) and see how long a real drift — like the opening scenario's console resize — could sit undetected. The average is half the interval if drift is equally likely on any day; the worst case is the full interval.
